subject: Okta consolidation: procurement & PO scheduling
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Okta consolidation: next steps for procurement

Hi Grace / Vivek —

Kevin from Okta sent the updated SOW (attached) after our workshop last week. The key ask from procurement is that we:
- Confirm scope (SSO + MFA + device posture agent rollout across 4 teams)
- Provide an intended PO date and budget code
- Sign off on the final pricing sheet (he attached a short summary)

Can you confirm the scope is locked or if we want to carve out the device posture pilot from the year-1 PO? I want to avoid a two-PO split unless necessary.

I attached Okta_SOW_v3.pdf and the pricing_summary.xlsx from Kevin.

Thanks — I can join a quick sync if helpful.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of IT Platform Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Okta consolidation: next steps for procurement

Mina —

Quick read-through: scope looks right for SSO + MFA across all user types. Device posture rollout has higher risk and we still need a smaller pilot to validate UA (UEM) integration and policy denial behavior — recommend

Option A: Single PO covering SSO/MFA now + an allowance line for a device posture pilot (TBD PO amendment)
Option B: Two POs: PO1 for SSO/MFA (Jan–Dec support) + PO2 for device posture once pilot completes (Q3)

I lean to Option A to avoid duplicate contracting overhead but include a capped pilot line item to keep finance comfortable. If procurement prefers two POs we should be explicit about timing to avoid gap in support.

Happy to run the pilot scoping doc with the security team this week.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Kevin Jones <kevin.jones@okta.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Fisk <laura.fisk@vendorservices.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Okta consolidation: next steps for procurement

Mina / team —

Thanks for the thoughtful read. Per Grace's Option A suggestion, I've attached a version of the SOW that includes a capped pilot line for device posture (Okta_SOW_v3.pdf) and an itemized pricing_summary.xlsx that shows retained support if the pilot converts.

If you want the pilot completely separate we can issue a standalone amendment later — no issue on our side. For timelines: our legal says a PO + countersigned SOW can get teams on the roster for onboarding in 4–6 weeks.

I've also attached a DocuSign link for the SOW if you want to move to signatures: https://www.docusign.net/DocuSign/transaction/ABC123DEF

Let me know if you need a version with split invoicing for finance.

Best,
Kevin Jones
Enterprise Sales, Okta
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Okta consolidation: next steps for procurement

Team —

I looped procurement and legal into ticket PR-1128 (link below). Procurement asked for two things before they can raise a PO:
1) Confirm the budget code and GL string (cost center: IT-PLAT-OPS / GL: 5420)
2) Provide the redwood_po_template.xlsx populated with line items we want invoiced now vs later

I've attached the template (redwood_po_template.xlsx). Can you each flag which approach you want in the template (Option A with capped pilot vs Option B split PO) and mark the expected invoice schedule.

Procurement also prefers a single PO if the pilot is <$75k; otherwise they want a separate PO for the pilot. Based on Kevin's pricing, the pilot as scoped is around $62k so Option A should be acceptable to finance.

Procurement ticket: https://app.redwood.internal/procurement/tickets/PR-1128

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Kevin Jones <kevin.jones@okta.com>, Laura Fisk <laura.fisk@vendorservices.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Okta consolidation: next steps for procurement

Kevin / Laura / Steph —

Thanks — we are proceeding with Option A (single PO with capped pilot line). Stephanie has the template and will submit the populated PO to procurement later today (using IT-PLAT-OPS / GL: 5420).

Two asks before I sign:
- Confirm that the pilot cap of $75k is a hard cap and that Okta will provide an itemized monthly invoice for the pilot phase.
- Add a clause in the SOW that network deny flows are tested in pre-prod and that Okta will provide rollback guidance if device posture policies cause unexpected denials.

If you can confirm both we will approve the DocuSign SOW and Stephanie will issue the PO.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — planning to onboard the SSO/MFA stack in late March once PO and SOW finalize.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of IT Platform Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Okta_SOW_v3.pdf (attachment), pricing_summary.xlsx (attachment), redwood_po_template.xlsx (attachment)
